ios.desc:
“Welcome to cab2ride the easiest way to get around “

With Cab2ride you can book a taxi from your any smartphone in just a one click and in seconds. The app uses GPS technology to directly connect you with a neast driver within a range right when you need it.
Cab2ride is designed to improve safety by allowing you to view driver’s name and rating as well as the vehicle information before a ride. You can also see as the driver approaches in real time and rate him or her at the end of the ride.
It is a global app that is working on http://cab2ride.com dispatch platform. You can book a taxi in any location where Cab2ride platform is in operation.

List of locations is coming soon.
In New York City work with Five Star Car Service and more to come.. Enjoy your trip and remember to rate your driver !

*This app may use your location even when it isn’t open, which can decrease device battery life
